brief: @buildthis.bisks.net an app that lets me sign in with my bluesky account then loads all my muted words and lets me submit the url of a post an then tells me which of my muted words are contained in that post
note: built mutedcheck.bisks.net — sign in, it loads your muted words straight from your PDS, then paste any post URL and it tells you which of them (if any) show up in it.
